limits: Code/descriptor inspection does not execute client logic or establish feature activation, native prediction, server compatibility, or gameplay acceptance.
Descriptor-file equality includes options such as Go package paths; differing files do not necessarily have differing field schemas.
Static catalog fields are covered only by the separate verified-header/resource inventory, not native semantic decoding in this supplement.
method: Bundled xdis6.1.8 parses code objects and disassembles using each pyc magic/version, no client code is executed. Python2 pyj is zlib decompressed before parse. Python3 Unicode marshal decoding uses surrogatepass to preserve lone surrogates rejected by unmodified xdis. Descriptor constants parsed as FileDescriptorProto. No cross-major code-equivalence conclusion.

sameVersionStructuralComparison.notPerformed: Python2.7 vs Python3.12 instruction sets differ; structural equality counts would be misleading.
